### Windows x64 downloads

- Gunnertimes-Setup.exe installs for your Windows user and bundles Java 25.
- Gunnertimes-Portable.jar requires Java 25 x64. Run `java -jar Gunnertimes-Portable.jar` from a writable folder.

Release checks work anonymously even when the GitHub REST API reaches its rate limit. This release separates the launcher update channel from pack updates and reuses assets, libraries and game versions in the standard Minecraft directory. Existing profiles keep their configs, mods and saves. Help topics now scroll independently of the article. The globe menu switches between English and فارسی.

Launcher source revision: de6c4f3. [Bundled Java source](https://github.com/microsoft/openjdk-jdk25u/tree/release/jdk-25.0.2_10).
